name: Fragment
description: Telegram's official marketplace on TON for collectible Telegram usernames and anonymous +888 numbers (direct sales and auctions), plus purchases of Telegram Premium, Telegram Stars and Telegram Ads payments. No official public trading API or published contract addresses; agents can only read collectible info via the Telegram API.

offchainApis.name: Telegram MTProto API: fragment.getCollectibleInfo
offchainApis.use: Read-only: given inputCollectibleUsername(username) or inputCollectiblePhone(phone), returns fragment.collectibleInfo (purchase_date, currency, amount, crypto_currency, crypto_amount, url to the Fragment page). Requires a logged-in Telegram user session (MTProto); bots cannot call it. Not a simple REST key.

offchainApis.name: Telegram MTProto API: username management (account/bots/channels.toggleUsername, reorderUsernames, channels.deactivateAllUsernames)
offchainApis.use: After owning a collectible username, activate/deactivate it or reorder usernames on a user, bot or channel.

actions.name: lookup-collectible
actions.description: Get purchase price/date and Fragment URL of a collectible username or number

actions.name: buy-or-bid
actions.description: Buy a username/number or bid in an auction
actions.how: No official programmatic route: a human uses fragment.com with a TON wallet connected (TON Connect) and Telegram login. Agents should give the user the fragment.com link.

actions.name: buy-stars-or-premium
actions.description: Buy Telegram Stars or gift Premium
actions.how: fragment.com web flow only (TON payment); no official API documented.

actions.name: use-username
actions.description: Attach an owned collectible username to an account, bot or channel

risks: No official public API or contract-address list for Fragment; third-party 'Fragment APIs' are unofficial and may require handing over wallet keys or Telegram sessions.
Collectibles are TON NFTs but their usefulness depends on Telegram, which controls the platform and its terms (https://fragment.com/terms).
Purchases require both a TON wallet and a Telegram account login on fragment.com.
notes: Fragment's own site (fragment.com/about) documents no API and no smart-contract addresses, and Telegram's API docs say ownership is secured on TON without giving addresses, so `contracts` is intentionally empty. The underlying contract code is published by Telegram as Telemint (https://github.com/TelegramMessenger/telemint): NftCollection/NftItem (plus NoDns variants) with auction ops teleitem_msg_start_auction (0x487a8e81), teleitem_msg_cancel_auction (0x371638ae), first-bid deploy telemint_msg_deploy (0x4637289a, needs a server-signed query), later bids as plain TON transfers, and the standard TON NFT transfer interface. The Telemint README does not name Fragment or list deployed collection addresses, so the username/number collection addresses circulating on explorers were not added. Telegram Stars and Premium purchases are web-only.
